lines.en: My tail drags a line behind me.
Walking by the smell of the cave mouth.
Traveling on the shaded side of the dune.
Hopping over a puddle in the cave.

lines.zh: 我蹲在洞里看你，眼睛会发光。
lines.en: I crouch in the cave watching you, eyes glowing.
Stashing fruit in a rock crack.
Washing my face with my paws.
Watching drips fall from the ceiling.
Wrapping my tail around my feet.

lines.zh: 我的胡须在抖，正估你的距离。
lines.en: My whiskers twitch as I gauge the distance to you.
In the dripstone cave, my eyes catch the light.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在黑暗里发光。
lines.en: My eyes glow in the dark.

lines.zh: 你的靴子能装不少果子。
lines.en: Your boots could hold plenty of fruit.
Don't crush the moss in here.

lines.zh: 我疼得吱吱叫，眼睛还亮。
lines.en: I squeal in pain, eyes still glowing.

lines.zh: 沙洞里滚出来，鼠人之眼还亮。
lines.en: Out of the sand hole, the rat eye still glows.

lines.zh: 盯着发光的眼睛，你难以抗拒。
lines.en: Staring at the glowing eye, you can’t resist.

lines.zh: 这些小家伙吃起东西来毫不含糊。
lines.en: These little guys are not picky eaters.
Find a meal in the depths of the cave.

lines.zh: 发光的眼睛指引你寻找食物。
lines.en: The glowing eye guides you to food.

lines.zh: 找到一个安静的地方享用美食。
lines.en: Find a quiet place to enjoy the meal.

lines.zh: 发光的眼睛让你难以忽视。
lines.en: The glowing eye catches your attention.

lines.zh: 这发光的眼睛是珍贵的资源。
lines.en: This glowing eye is a valuable resource.

lines.zh: 在洞穴中搜寻发光的眼睛。
lines.en: Search the cave for glowing eyes.

lines.zh: 找到发光的眼睛，意味着找到食物。
lines.en: Find the glowing eye, and you find food.

lines.zh: 发光的眼睛让洞穴更加神秘。
lines.en: The glowing eye makes the cave more mysterious.

lines.zh: 发光的眼睛我藏了好几颗。
用鼠人之眼换你的果子？
lines.en: A ratman's eye for your fruit?
Deeper in the cave, the eyes glow brighter.

lines.zh: 这双眼睛能换一把好剑。
lines.en: These eyes buy a fine sword.

lines.zh: 跟我来，我领你去藏货处。
lines.en: Come along. I'll show you my stash.

lines.zh: 沙丘下有我的秘密仓库。
lines.en: My secret hoard is under the dune.

lines.zh: 它们会用身体来阻挡你。
lines.en: They block your path with their bodies.

lines.zh: 小心，它们会用头撞击你。
它们会通过碰撞来互动。
用头撞你，它们似乎在挑衅。
lines.en: Headbutting you, they seem to challenge you.
After the collision, they step aside.

lines.zh: 它们用身体挡住你的去路。
lines.en: They block your path with their bodies.

lines.zh: 它们试图通过碰撞来吸引注意。
lines.en: They try to attract attention through collisions.
They remain alert after the collision.

lines.zh: 它们用身体来保护自己的领地。
lines.en: They use their bodies to protect their territory.

lines.zh: 它们寻找伴侣来繁衍后代。
在洞穴中寻找合适的伴侣。
lines.en: Find a suitable partner in the cave.

lines.zh: 通过叫声来吸引潜在伴侣。
寻找洞穴中的潜在伴侣。
lines.en: Search for potential partners in the cave.

lines.zh: 通过叫声来表达求偶意图。
lines.en: Express your mating intentions with calls.
Call out to attract a mate.

lines.zh: 在洞穴中寻找交配对象。
lines.en: Find a mate in the cave.
This dry ration gets dragged into my hole.
Tasty treat from the stone cave.
Big apple in the cave depths.
Sweet fruits in the desert too.

lines.zh: 鼠人喜欢这些甜甜的果实！
这棵大树上有好多果子！
lines.en: Lots of fruit on that tree.

lines.zh: 滴水石洞里的果子很好吃！
lines.en: Delicious fruits from the stone cave.
Prey in the deep stone cave!

lines.zh: 滴水石洞里的移动猎物！
lines.en: Moving prey in the stone cave!

lines.zh: 丛林里的小动物，上来吧！
lines.en: Little animal in the jungle, come out!
Movement in the deep stone cave!
Targeted, two for the price of one!

lines.zh: 我手里的鼠眼，正照着你的方向。
lines.en: The rat eye in my hand points your way.
Targeted, prey in the stone cave!
From the cave roof, I draw the bow full.

lines.zh: 我盯住你手里的果子了。
lines.en: I've got my eye on your fruit.

lines.zh: 我挖洞捡的石头，你别摸。
lines.en: Hands off the shiny rock I dug up.

lines.zh: 惨叫一声，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Squeals in pain — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 痛苦嘶喊，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Screams in agony — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 尖叫着倒下，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Shrieks in agony — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 哀嚎连连，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Howls in pain — and the projectile makes it worse.
My rat eye grows hot under the spell.

lines.zh: 痛苦哀鸣，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Sobs in pain — and the starvation makes it worse.
Not even a squeak in the void.
